prompts.name: wall_straight
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wall_straight, a single isolated reference sprite for image-to-3D reconstruction of a modular hotel wall. Make an ORIGINAL dark gothic comic game asset, cozy and faintly sinister, late-20th-century grand-hotel furnishings; no movie, filmmaker, character, franchise or recognizable set reference. One physical object only, transparent background, full object uncropped with generous empty margins, no floor, no base platform, no surrounding scene, no text or diagram or cast shadow.
Geometry: a straight upright rectangular wall slab with exact visual proportions WIDTH 1 : DEPTH 0.3 : HEIGHT 1.7. Front decorated, back flat. Clean perfectly straight flush vertical ends and flat top/bottom allow identical slabs to join seamlessly. No side pillars, no end cap ornament jutting beyond the width. Show a near-front orthographic three-quarter view, about 20 degrees horizontal turn and 10 degrees elevation, so the broad front, narrow right edge, and a little top are visible. No perspective convergence.
Front design: lower THIRD dark walnut wainscoting with two broad recessed rectangular panels, subtly bevelled rectangular frames and heavy baseboard; a thin continuous aged brass chair rail exactly at one-third wall height; upper two-thirds deep oxblood/burgundy wallpaper with a moderately sized repeating gothic botanical damask motif. Abstract sly smiling curves hidden very subtly in the botanical pattern, not a face or character. Restrained dark walnut stepped crown molding across the top, straight modular seams. Palette oxblood #5A1A1E, walnut #3B2418, brass #B08A3E, subtle amber highlights #F2B35C, ink shadow #1A0E10. Warm, rich but clearly readable.
Style: stylized low-poly form translated into a crisp hand-painted comic sprite, strong clean silhouettes, restrained ink outlines, graphic shadow planes and small visible pixel-like texture clusters, no photorealism, no blurry painterly brushwork. Slightly irregular decorative carving inside the panels, while the outer modular dimensions stay rectangular. Even neutral warm illumination sufficient to see geometry, no baked spotlight. This is the master style for a matching wall kit. Output a high-resolution portrait PNG with real transparency.
